The mapping between messages a1 a2 a3 a4 and respective codewords a1 a2 a3 r3 a4 r2 r1 of a $(7,4)$ block code is obtained by adding even-parity-check bits $r 1, r 2$ and $r 3$ at the 7 th, 6th and 4th bit-location of the resultant codeword. $\mathrm{r} 3=\mathrm{a} 1 \oplus \mathrm{a} 2 \oplus \mathrm{a} 3$
